strings.설리(Surly)는 미국 미네소타의 자전거 유통사 QBP(Quality: Surly is a steel bike brand that grew out of Quality Bicycle Products (QBP), a bicycle distributor in Minnesota, USA. Its first catalog came out in 1998 around a single-speed frame called the 1x1, and the Surly name followed the next year. From the start, the goal was never a light, fast race bike. It was a bike you ride for years, load up, and take anywhere.
strings.29인치 산악자전거, 팻바이크, 롱테일 카고 바이크처럼 당시에는 낯설던: Surly built 29-inch mountain bikes, fat bikes and longtail cargo bikes early, back when those genres still felt strange. Serious design from people who don't take themselves too seriously: that sense of humor is part of what makes Surly, Surly.
strings.모델마다 용도에 맞춘 크로몰리 튜빙: Chromoly tubing chosen for each model's job
strings.싱글스피드 프레임 1x1에서 시작: It started with the 1x1 single-speed frame
strings.모회사 QBP와 함께 B Corp 인증: B Corp certified with parent company QBP
strings.설리는 스틸이 자신들이 설계하고 타는 자전거에 가장 잘 맞는 소재라고 말: Surly says steel is the best material for the bikes it designs and rides. Tubing is chosen for each model's purpose, and the comfortable, compliant ride that results is what Surly calls the “Surly Ride.”
strings.넉넉한 타이어 클리어런스와 랙, 펜더, 보틀 마운트. 출퇴근부터 장거리: Generous tire clearance plus rack, fender and bottle mounts. One bike that handles many jobs, from the commute to long tours.
strings.저지와 클릿이 없어도, 평상복 그대로 타면 됩니다. 체형도 목적도 다른: No jersey or cleats needed. Just ride in your everyday clothes. A wide spread of sizes and wheel sizes lets riders of every build and purpose find their fit.
strings.기어 많은 자전거가 유행하던 1998년, 설리의 첫 프레임은 기어 하나뿐: In 1998, when bikes with ever more gears were in fashion, Surly's first frame was a single-speed with just one.
strings.첫 카탈로그에는 싱글스피드 프레임 1x1과 체인 텐셔너 싱글에이터(Sin: The first catalog featured the 1x1 single-speed frame and the Singleator chain tensioner. Then came the all-rounder Cross-Check (2000), the 29-inch Karate Monkey (2003), the Long Haul Trucker touring frame (2004) and the Pugsley fat bike (2005), and Surly became the byword for steel bikes with a clear purpose.
strings.지금의 라인업도 같은 생각 위에 있습니다. 루비워크샵이 주력으로 다루는: Today's lineup rests on the same idea. The four models Rubi Workshop focuses on, Midnight Special, Preamble, Straggler and Disc Trucker, represent Surly's road-going range, from daily pavement to gravel and long-distance touring.

strings.포장도로를 빠르고 편하게, 가끔 만나는 그래블까지. 굵은 650B 타이어: Fast and comfortable on pavement, ready for the odd gravel stretch. An endurance road bike on big 650B tires.
strings.설리 스틸 바이크의 입문. 출퇴근과 일상, 가벼운 그래블을 위한 플랫바·: The way into Surly steel. Flat bar and drop bar versions for commuting, everyday riding and light gravel.
strings.포장도로가 끝나는 곳에서 시작하는 설리의 그래블 바이크. 50mm 타이어: Surly's gravel bike, built for where the pavement ends. 50mm tires and stable geometry.
strings.짐을 가득 싣고 세계 어디든. 수많은 장거리 여행으로 검증된 설리의 정통: Fully loaded, anywhere in the world. Surly's classic drop bar touring bike, proven on countless long tours.
strings.미드나잇 스페셜(Midnight Special)은 설리가 '로드 플러스': The Midnight Special is the endurance road bike Surly calls “road plus.” It keeps a road bike's efficiency and lively handling, but puts comfort first with a relaxed position you can hold all day and big tires.
strings.650B×50mm 타이어를 기준으로 설계했고 700C는 42mm까지 들어: It is designed around 650B×50mm tires and also fits 700C up to 42mm. Big tires soak up cracked asphalt, potholes and surprise gravel, and lower pressures give you a wider contact patch. For mostly pavement with some gravel, choose the Midnight Special. For gravel-heavy riding, the Straggler is the better fit.
strings.650B×50mm 기준 설계, 700C×42mm 대응. 펜더를 달아도 6: Designed around 650B×50mm, fits 700C×42mm. With fenders it still takes 650B×50mm or 700C×38mm.
strings.앞뒤 12mm 스루액슬, 플랫 마운트 디스크 브레이크, 44mm 헤드튜브: 12mm thru-axles front and rear, flat mount disc brakes and a 44mm head tube. Standards that work with today's parts.
strings.보틀 마운트 3개와 앞뒤 랙·펜더 마운트로 긴 하루의 짐을 싣습니다. 다: Three bottle mounts plus front and rear rack and fender mounts carry what a long day needs. Downtube shifter bosses are still there too.
strings.40부터 64까지 8개 사이즈로, 권장 신장 147cm부터 203cm까지: Eight sizes from 40 to 64 cover recommended rider heights from 147cm to 203cm.
strings.새 블랙 체리 피즈(Black Cherry Fizz) 700C 완성차는: The new Black Cherry Fizz 700C complete is Surly's first bike to pair a steel frame with carbon. A Salsa Waxwing carbon fork and Teravail carbon rims cut weight and road buzz, while the frame stays chromoly steel.
strings.카본 포크에도 쓰리팩 마운트와 로라이더 랙 마운트가 있어 짐을 싣는 쓰임: The carbon fork still has three-pack mounts and low-rider rack mounts, so it can carry a load. The frameset and the other completes use a chromoly fork with rack mounts.

strings.프리앰블(Preamble)은 설리 스틸 자전거의 입문 모델입니다. 출퇴근: The Preamble is Surly's entry into steel bikes. It is made for commuting, city riding and everyday use, and leaves out features many riders never touch, such as adjustable dropouts and extra mounts, to stay simple and affordable.
strings.더블 버티드 크로몰리 메인 트라이앵글이 포트홀과 거친 노면을 부드럽게 걸: A double-butted chromoly main triangle smooths out potholes and rough roads, and front and rear racks, fenders and two bottle cages make a rainy commute easy. Choose the flat bar for quick handling in the city or the drop bar for longer rides and headwinds.
strings.같은 프레임 지오메트리에 핸들바만 다릅니다. 도심 위주라면 플랫바, 장거: Same frame geometry, different handlebars. Flat bar for mostly city riding, drop bar if you often go long.
strings.XS와 S는 650B 휠과 슬로핑 탑튜브로 스탠드오버를 낮췄고, M부터: XS and S use 650B wheels and a sloping top tube for lower standover. M through XL use 700C.
strings.앞뒤 랙, 앞뒤 펜더, 보틀 2개. 펜더를 달아도 41mm 타이어가 그대: Front and rear racks, front and rear fenders, two bottles. Even with fenders, 41mm tires still fit.
strings.가끔 만나는 비포장 길까지. 30km가 넘는 그래블 라이딩이 잦다면 스트: Ready for the occasional dirt path. If you often ride gravel for more than 30km, we recommend the Straggler.
strings.설리는 프리앰블을 커스텀 빌드의 출발점으로도 소개합니다. 공식 블로그에는: Surly also presents the Preamble as a starting point for custom builds. Its blog features examples like the “Impossible Preamble,” rebuilt with lightweight parts.

strings.스트래글러(Straggler)는 설리의 그래블 전용 바이크입니다. 설리: The Straggler is Surly's dedicated gravel bike. Surly's engineers refined it on Midwest gravel, for riders who turn a wrong turn into an all-day adventure.
strings.50mm 타이어 클리어런스로 접지와 승차감을 챙기고, 긴 하루에도 흔들림: 50mm tire clearance brings traction and comfort, and stable geometry keeps long days calm. It's quick enough that the paved ride out to the gravel never drags, so one bike can also handle the commute and light bikepacking.
strings.650B와 700C 모두 50mm까지, 펜더를 달아도 47mm까지 들어갑: Up to 50mm on both 650B and 700C, and up to 47mm with fenders.
strings.새 스트래글러는 앞뒤 12mm 스루액슬과 플랫 마운트 디스크 브레이크로: The new Straggler moves to 12mm thru-axles front and rear and flat mount disc brakes.
strings.드로퍼 포스트 내부 라우팅을 갖춰 거친 내리막에서 안장을 낮출 수 있습니: Internal dropper post routing lets you drop the saddle on rough descents.
strings.보틀 마운트 2개와 쓰리팩 마운트 1개, 랙·펜더 마운트로 바이크패킹 장: Two bottle mounts, one three-pack mount and rack and fender mounts carry your bikepacking gear.
strings.46부터 52까지는 650B, 54부터 64까지는 700C 휠을 기준으로: Sizes 46 to 52 are designed around 650B wheels and 54 to 64 around 700C. Matching the wheel to the rider keeps small frames naturally proportioned.
strings.650B 사이즈는 26인치×50mm, 700C 사이즈는 650B×50mm: 650B sizes also take 26"×50mm, and 700C sizes also take 650B×50mm, so you can swap wheelsets on one bike.

strings.디스크 트러커(Disc Trucker)는 설리의 정통 드롭바 투어링 바이: The Disc Trucker is Surly's pure-bred drop bar touring bike. It is made to carry heavy loads across continents and around the world on mostly paved roads, and its stability and durability have been proven on countless long tours.
strings.림 브레이크 투어러 롱 홀 트러커의 디스크 브레이크 버전으로 2012년에: It arrived in 2012 as the disc brake version of the rim brake Long Haul Trucker and was redesigned into its current form in 2020. Its carrying capacity and calm road manners also make it a great everyday bike for commuting and errands.
strings.쓰리팩 마운트 2세트, 상·중·하단 랙 마운트, 펜더 마운트, 다이나모: A chromoly fork with two sets of three-pack mounts, upper, mid and lower rack mounts, fender mounts and dynamo routing.
strings.앞뒤 12mm 스루액슬. 논드라이브 쪽이 슬롯 구조라 액슬을 완전히 빼지: 12mm thru-axles front and rear. The non-drive side is slotted, so the wheel comes out without pulling the axle all the way.
strings.시트스테이의 여분 스포크 홀더와 킥스탠드 플레이트. 길 위에서 필요한 것: A spare spoke holder on the seatstay and a kickstand plate. What you need on the road, built into the frame.
strings.1x 47T, 2x 50/34T, 3x 56/47/33T까지 대응. 짐을: Fits up to 1x 47T, 2x 50/34T or 3x 56/47/33T, so you can gear it for long loaded climbs.
strings.디스크 트러커는 42부터 54까지 26인치, 56부터 64까지 700C: The Disc Trucker uses 26" wheels on sizes 42 to 54 and 700C on 56 to 64. Surly treats wheel size as a fit decision, because changing it also changes cockpit length, steering angles and toe overlap.
strings.두 휠 모두 47mm급 타이어가 들어가고, 펜더를 달아도 클리어런스가 그: Both wheel sizes take tires around 47mm wide, with the same clearance with fenders. 26" tires and tubes are easy to find in many parts of the world, which makes them a reassuring choice on long tours.
